summary: The round-1 source-level required fixes have been addressed. The manuscript now has real author and affiliation text, consistently uses gpt-5.5 low raw for the salvage condition, explains the 2-review plus third-adjudication scoring process, points to the final ledger and aggregate CSVs, and preserves the necessary Stage 3 boundary that alert-summary rows are hidden while EDR/OS telemetry remains available. I find no remaining main.tex content or numeric fixes required. The only remaining strict-professor block is FIT submission readiness: a compiled PDF must still be checked for page count, A4 size, file size, embedded fonts, and layout/overfull issues.
